HelpProgressLabel: 9 steps • Quick guide to Tune Master
HelpStep1Text:
Start typing make, model or year in the search box — the car list auto-filters. Select a car from the dropdown: make, model and year fill in automatically. If your car isn't in the database, just enter the data manually in the fields below.

• ↻ button — refreshes the car database from the Forza server
• 🗑 button — clears database and spec cache (requires reload)
• ✕ button — clears the current selection

The car database loads automatically on startup and is cached locally. Load status is shown in the bottom status bar.
HelpStep1Note: Tip: after selecting a car from the database, make, model, year, engine type, aspiration, drive type, position, mass, power, torque, weight distribution and gear count auto-fill from the wiki. Remaining specs enter manually or use AI fetch (step 3).
HelpStep2Text:
Fill in the essential car specifications:

• MASS & BALANCE — total mass (kg) and front weight distribution (%).
• ENGINE — powertrain type (ICE / Hybrid / Electric), power, peak torque, max RPM, engine type and position, aspiration, fuel type and anti-lag.
• TRANSMISSION — drive type (FWD / RWD / AWD), gear count (1–10).

For electric vehicles (BEV), aspiration, fuel type and anti-lag fields auto-hide. Hybrids inherit ICE parameters.
HelpStep2Note: Check 'Calculate gear ratios' to compute all gear steps. 'Final drive only' calculates just the final drive ratio. Diesel gets short first gear and tight spacing due to its narrow power band. Peak power and torque are calculated automatically from entered data. Weight distribution loads from the car card; if no data — the generator estimates it from engine position (Front 55%, Mid 48%, Rear 40%).
HelpStep3Text:
In TIRES & WHEELS, set front and rear tire width, profile, rim diameter and tire type. Tire type affects base pressure (Slick: 2.24 bar, Sport: 2.07, Offroad: 2.00, etc.) and sidewall stiffness.

Click 'AI: fetch specs' to auto-fill wheelbase, track, Cd and frontal area via API. Estimated values are marked with ⚠ — verify before generating.
HelpStep3Note:
In UPGRADES, choose suspension, differential and brake upgrade levels:
• Suspension: Sport+ enables spring and ride height tuning. Race gives the widest range.
• Differential: Sport+ enables lock tuning.
• Brakes: affects system pressure.
HelpStep4Text:
Set allowed ranges that the generator must stay within:

• SPRINGS — front/rear stiffness (N/mm or kgf/mm). Based on mass and weight distribution.
• RIDE HEIGHT — front/rear ground clearance (mm). Affects center of gravity.
• AERO — front/rear downforce range. Only available with aero kit installed (checkboxes in UPGRADES).
• DIFFERENTIAL — accel/decel lock (%). For AWD also center diff bias.
HelpStep4Note: Spring and ride height sections are visible only with Sport / Race / Rally / Drift / Offroad suspension. Center diff bias (0% = front, 100% = rear) is only for AWD. If no aero kit is installed, uncheck and leave fields empty.
HelpStep5Text:
Choose a discipline — it determines target spring frequencies, wheel geometry, gear ratios and tire pressure:

• Road — tarmac, balanced handling
• Touge — mountain passes, precise corner entry
• Drift — controlled oversteer, angle and slide
• Drag — straight line, max launch
• Rally — mixed surface, soft suspension
• Cross Country — off-road, max travel
• Street — urban, speed and maneuverability

For Drag, also set the distance (¼, ½ mile or mile).
HelpStep5Note: Click ⚡ Generate at the bottom of the left panel. Or check ✓ Auto in the right panel header — the tune auto-recalculates on any data change (~400 ms debounce). Generation status is shown in the status bar and overlay.
HelpStep6Text: The right panel displays all generated tune parameters, organized into sections:
HelpStep7Text:
In Drag mode, a Launch Control block appears above the main parameters with optimal launch RPM. Hold throttle at this RPM before the green light.

Calculation accounts for: aspiration type (turbos need pre-spooling), torque peak (lower peak = lower launch RPM), drive type (AWD can launch at higher RPM), fuel type (diesel gets lower RPM due to early torque peak).
HelpStep8Text:
Profiles let you save and load full tune configurations:

• 💾 Save — stores car data, constraints and tune. Name auto-generated: Make_Model_Year_Drive_Discipline.
• Load — select a profile from the list to load immediately.
• + New — resets all fields to defaults.
• 🗑 Delete — removes the selected profile.

Profiles saved with an older version are automatically recalculated on startup — outdated data formats update without any action needed.

Profiles are stored as JSON files in %APPDATA%\ForzaTuneMaster\profiles\.
HelpStep8Note:
Units and language toggle in the top bar:
• Metric / Imperial — affects all unit displays
• Power: HP / PS / kW
• Spring rate: N/mm · kgf/mm · lb/in
• Interface language: Русский / English

All internal calculations use SI (metric) units — imperial conversion is for display only.
HelpStep9Text:
Tune results can be displayed in a separate floating window on top of other apps:

• TOGGLE — check the «Overlay» box in the right panel header or press Ctrl+Shift+O
• DRAG — hold the header and move anywhere on screen
• RESIZE — drag any corner of the window
• OPACITY — slider in the header (0.3–1.0)
• CLOSE — ✕ button in the header or press Ctrl+Shift+O again

Overlay position and size are automatically saved on close and restored on next open.

The overlay is independent from the main window: it won't minimize with it and can hold focus separately.
HelpStep6Line1: • TIRE PRESSURE — front/rear. Base from tire type, mass and weight distribution adjust non-linearly.
HelpStep6Line2: • WHEEL ALIGNMENT — camber (discipline + load + aero), caster (mass + speed), toe (drive + discipline + speed)
HelpStep6Line3: • ANTI-ROLL BARS (ARB) — stiffness front/rear. Based on discipline, mass, track, weight distribution and body roll.
HelpStep6Line4: • SPRINGS + RIDE HEIGHT — stiffness: k = 0.0197 × Hz² × mass × wtDist. Height: from discipline, suspension, engine position.
HelpStep6Line5: • DAMPERS — rebound/bump (1–20). Base from discipline, adjusted for mass, weight dist, drive type and aspiration.
HelpStep6Line6: • AERODYNAMICS — downforce front/rear. Based on max constraints × drive factor × speed × power. Drift/CC/Rally get reduced.
HelpStep6Line7: • DIFFERENTIAL — accel/decel lock. Based on discipline/drive, power and torque. AWD: separate front + center diff.
HelpStep6Line8: • BRAKES — balance (% front) = weight dist + discipline offset. Pressure: from discipline, mass and speed.
HelpStep6Line9: • GEARING — final drive targeting max speed, ratios (geometric progression). First/top gear from discipline.
HelpStep6Line10: Hover over any value — tooltip explains the physics. The gear chart below shows speed range per gear; vertical lines mark peak power (orange) and peak torque (blue).
Expl_TirePressureReason_Drag: Drag: neutral front (~32 PSI), min rear (~18-20 PSI) for max launch grip.
Expl_TirePressureReason_Drift: Drift: ~25 PSI front / ~22 PSI rear for predictable sliding.
Expl_TirePressureReason_Rally: Rally/CC: lower pressure for maximum contact patch.
Expl_TirePressureReason_CrossCountry: Rally/CC: lower pressure for maximum contact patch.
Expl_TirePressureReason_Touge: Touge: slightly softer than base for mountain road grip.
Expl_TirePressureReason_Street: Street: standard pressure with slight rear margin for maneuvers.
Expl_CamberReason_Drag: Drag: minimal camber — maximum contact patch at launch.
Expl_CamberReason_Drift: Drift: aggressive front camber for control at high steering angles.
Expl_CamberReason_Rally: Rally: moderate camber — flat contact patch on gravel.
Expl_CamberReason_CrossCountry: CC: minimal camber — maximum contact on bumps.
Expl_CamberReason_Touge: Touge: increased camber for precise corner entry on tight turns.
Expl_CamberReason_Road: Road: classic negative camber to compensate for body roll in corners.
Expl_ARBNote_Drag: Drag: min front for weight transfer; stiff rear for platform.
Expl_ARBNote_DriftRWD: Drift: soft front for initiation; moderate rear for angle hold (ForzaFire R20-25).
Expl_ARBNote_Rally: Rally: soft for independent wheel travel on gravel.
Expl_ARBNote_CrossCountry: CC: min stiffness for suspension articulation.
Expl_ARBNote_TougeRWD: Touge RWD: stiffer for precise control.
Expl_ARBNote_TougeFWD: Touge FWD: soft front for grip, stiff rear for rotation.
Expl_ARBNote_StreetFWD: Street FWD: soft front for grip, stiffer rear against understeer.
Expl_ARBNote_RoadRWD: Road RWD: front stiffer than rear for precise entry (ForzaFire F18-28/R12-20).
Expl_ARBNote_RoadFWD: Road FWD: soft front (grip), stiffer rear (rotation).
Expl_ARBNote_RoadAWD: Road AWD: F26/R33 — balanced ARBs (ForzaFire F22-30/R28-38).
Expl_Springs_Fmt: Springs: F {0} / R {1} N/mm ({2:F2}/{3:F2} Hz, suspension {4}).
Expl_Springs_Defaults_Fmt: Springs: F {0} / R {1} N/mm (default values, tuning unavailable).
Expl_RideHeightNote_Drag: Drag: min clearance for aero, low CG; slight rear rake for weight transfer at launch.
Expl_RideHeightNote_Drift: Drift: low ride height for stability in slides.
Expl_RideHeightNote_Rally: Rally: high clearance for uneven terrain.
Expl_RideHeightNote_CrossCountry: CC: max clearance for jumps and bumps.
Expl_RideHeightNote_Road: Road: min clearance for low CG.
Expl_RideHeightNote_Touge: Touge: low ride height with slight rear rake for rotation.
Expl_RideHeightNote_Street: Street: low ride height with a small margin for road imperfections.
Expl_Dampers_Fmt: Rebound: F {0} / R {1}, bump: F {2} / R {3}. (bump/rebound: F {4:F0}%, R {5:F0}%)
Expl_Dampers_Defaults_Fmt: Dampers: rebound F {0} / R {1}, bump F {2} / R {3} (default values).

Expl_AeroNote_Drag: Drag: minimum downforce for top speed.
Expl_AeroNote_Drift: Drift: minimum downforce for free sliding.
Expl_AeroNote_CrossCountry: CC: minimum downforce to avoid catching the terrain.
Expl_AeroNote_Street: Street: high downforce with a small top-speed reserve.
Expl_AeroNote_RoadFWD: Road FWD: front downforce for grip.
